<Heading
  as={"h1"}
  className={"openapi__heading"}
  children={"List messages in a conversation"}
>
</Heading>

<MethodEndpoint
  method={"get"}
  path={"/api/chat/conversations/{conversationId}/messages"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Newest first, cursor-paginated (`take` defaults to 30 and is capped at
100). The conversation must currently be accessible under the same
live family rules as the inbox. FAMILY results preserve the family
chat fields (`replyTo`, `readBy`) plus conversation metadata; PRIVATE
results contain only the direct conversation's participants and
payload. Unknown or inaccessible private conversations return `404`.
This route requires server feature `directMessages`.
